propositions: Debug skill never writes back tickets despite reading prior tickets; writebacks must be encoded at four lifecycle points (Phase-1 RCA, Reporting summary, not-a-bug classification, Step-7 siblings) with inline own-tracker-vs-third-party discriminator and approval-gate carve-out.

Step-7 sweep is construct-only and misses parity siblings (absence patterns invisible to grep); must decompose into two-axis sweep with OR trigger: axis-1 for repeatable construct patterns and axis-2 for parallel-surface code sites.

Step-7 axis-2 (parity census) requires 4 forced-artifact questions: NAME THE RULE (operation+property without site names), CHANNEL CENSUS (5-slot checklist: CLI/MCP-API/library/automated-callers/dual-direction), PER-SURFACE PROBE (cite path:line or flag MISSING), and DISPOSITION (RED-test fix or ticket with discovered_from).

Reporting framework must include residual-risk disposition item with forced disposition per observed fragility (ticket filed/accepted with reason/fixed in scope) or 'none observed' as legitimate outcome.

Own-tracker writebacks (the tracker producing the ticket under debug) bypass approval-gating; all other tracker mutations remain gated; discovered_from linkage stated inline in skill without AGENTS.md references.
